goal: Travel from Pewter City through Mt Moon to reach Cerulean City.

subgoals.goal_text: Visit the Pewter City Pokemon Center to ensure the party is fully healed before heading out.
Purchase Potions from the Pewter Mart for sustainability inside Mt Moon.
Leave Pewter City and enter Route 3.
Travel east across Route 3 to reach the entrance of Mt Moon.
Navigate through the first floor of Mt Moon and find the stairs leading down to B1F.
Navigate through the first basement and find the stairs leading down to B2F.
Locate and defeat the Super Nerd guarding the fossils on B2F.
Find the exit of Mt Moon and move to the Pokemon Center area.
Heal the party at the Mt Moon Pokemon Center before the final stretch.
Leave the Mt Moon Pokemon Center area and enter Route 4.
Travel east across Route 4 until you enter Cerulean City.
